name: Cult UI
notes: License verified via GitHub API (/repos/nolly-studio/cult-ui/license): SPDX 'MIT', file LICENSE.md (also stated in repo description). Repo: nolly-studio/cult-ui (~6.1k stars, active).

Docs URL pattern verified: https://cult-ui.com/docs/components/<slug> (Fumadocs MDX under apps/www/content/docs/components/, exactly 77 component pages, 1:1 with the 77 sidebar entries in apps/www/config/docs.ts). 'name' uses the sidebar display title; mdx frontmatter titles are usually React export identifiers (e.g. BgMedia for 'Bg Media Hero').

Categories are verbatim from the library's own sidebar config (12 groups): Marketing & Heroes, Buttons, Expandable Widgets, Cards & Surfaces, Frames & Mockups, Textures & Overlays, Visual Systems, Navigation & Floating UI, Inputs & Decision UI, AI & Productivity Widgets, Media, Typography & Text Effects.

Registry index https://cult-ui.com/r/registry.json (repo: apps/www/public/r/registry.json) has 157 items: 78 registry:ui components + 79 '-demo' preview items. The 78th ui item ('bg-animated-gradient') has no docs page and is excluded; the other 77 map 1:1 to docs pages.

Per-item registry pattern: https://cult-ui.com/r/<name>.json serves a static shadcn registry-item JSON (verified byte-level from apps/www/public/r/dither-image.json): $schema https://ui.shadcn.com/schema/registry-item.json, type registry:ui, description, dependencies, and files[] where each file has path + full source in content.
Install command format shown in every docs page (CLI tab): `npx shadcn@latest add https://cult-ui.com/r/<name>.json` (example: npx shadcn@latest add https://cult-ui.com/r/dither-image.json).

Live-site caveat: cult-ui.com currently returns HTTP 429 'Vercel Security Checkpoint' (X-Vercel-Mitigated: challenge) to curl/WebFetch from this environment, so live bytes could not be fetched directly; verification used the identical static files committed in the repo (public/ is deployed as-is) plus the /registry/[name] route handler which parses items with shadcnRegistryItemSchema and injects file content.

Slug/registry-name mismatches: docs page 'hero-color-panels' installs via /r/hero-color-panel.json (registry file exists). Docs page 'bg-animated-fractal-grid' (Fractal Grid) shows `npx shadcn@latest add https://cult-ui.com/r/bg-animated-fractal-grid.json`, but that file is MISSING from public/r (registry name is bg-animated-fractal-dot-grid) - the CLI command on that one page appears broken; use /r/bg-animated-fractal-dot-grid.json instead.

Paid tier: 'Cult Pro' is a separate product at https://pro.cult-ui.com (one-time ~$129 lifetime; 37 pro components + 129 sections per repo marketing lists at apps/www/lib/cult-pro-*-landing.json; own docs at pro.cult-ui.com/docs/components). None of the 77 components cataloged here are Pro-gated - all 77 are in the MIT repo with working /r/ endpoints, so no '(Pro-only)' markers were needed.

The repo also vendors base shadcn/ui primitives (accordion, dialog, form, etc. under apps/www/public/registry/styles/) purely as dependencies for the docs app; they are not part of Cult UI's documented component set and are excluded from this catalog.
